actions.description: Save a bank account a connected user can withdraw funds to.
actions.name: create-withdrawal-recipient

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the bank account. Example: "US"

iban.description: International wire: the IBAN (spaces ok, normalized on save).

country_specific.description: Country-specific banking fields, e.g. {"ifsc": "..."} for India or {"clabe": "..."} for Mexico.

actions.description: Poll a connected user's card attachment status.
actions.name: get-attachment-status

actions.description: Get a connected user's current identity verification status.
actions.name: get-kyc-status

actions.description: Check which organization and mode (sandbox/live) the current platform token acts as.
actions.name: introspect-credential

actions.description: List a connected user's saved, active withdrawal bank destinations.
actions.name: list-withdrawal-recipients

actions.description: List a connected user's most recent withdrawals across every rail.
actions.name: list-withdrawals

actions.description: Record that a connected user authorized your platform to act on their behalf.
actions.name: record-consent

terms_version.description: Optional. The version of your terms the user accepted, stored for your audit trail.

actions.description: Exchange a connected user's refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair before the access token expires.
actions.name: refresh-connection

refresh_token.description: The refresh token from the most recent verify or refresh call. Example: "rct_4d5e6f…"
The new refresh token. The old one is now invalid — replace the stored token every time.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires (3600 = one hour).

actions.description: Test-mode only: force a connected user's identity verification to a chosen terminal outcome instantly.
actions.name: simulate-kyc-outcome

reason.description: Optional end-user-safe explanation carried on non-approved outcomes.

actions.description: Start attaching a connected user's own existing Visa/Mastercard so their agent's purchases charge it directly (no KYC, no balance funding required).
actions.name: start-card-attachment

display.description: Display mode for the attachment flow. Defaults to "hosted".

attach_url.description: Hosted page URL to redirect the user to. Present when status is pending.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session expires. Present when status is pending.

card.description: Display details of the attached card. Present when status is active.

reason.description: Why the card cannot be attached. Present when status is ineligible.

message.description: Human-readable guidance. Present when status is ineligible.

actions.description: Send a one-time code to a user by email or phone to begin connecting them to your platform.
actions.name: start-connect

email.description: The user's email address. Provide this or phone, not both.

phone.description: The user's phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567). Provide this or email, not both.

external_user_id.description: Optional. Your own identifier for the user, stored on the attempt for your reference.

actions.description: Send a connected user a one-time code to their phone, required before wallet funding.
actions.name: start-phone-verification

phone_number.description: E.164 phone number to send the verification code to. Only used if the user has no phone on file; otherwise the on-file number is used instead. Example: "+15551234567"

actions.description: Submit the extra identity fields Agentcard requests after document upload.
actions.name: submit-kyc-information

phone_number.description: E.164 format with country code. Example: "+15551234567"

actions.description: Verify the one-time code and complete connecting the user, returning their connection token pair.
actions.name: verify-connect

connect_id.description: The connect attempt id returned by start-connect. Example: "ca_9f8e7d6c"

code.description: The one-time code the user entered. Always "111111" in sandbox.

actions.description: Verify the one-time phone code, unlocking wallet funding for 60 days.
actions.name: verify-phone-code

code.description: The one-time code the user entered. Always 111111 in sandbox.

phone_number.description: Required only when the code was sent to a number you provided. E.164 format (e.g. +14155550100).
